text:
sam: Heads-up: we're promoting the 'microburst-smoothing' patch to prod canary tonight at 02:00 UTC. Quick summary: reduces p99 tail amplification during short concurrent spikes and saves ~22% token-cost for bursty chat routes.

lee: Love it. What did the staging numbers look like? p50/p99/cost?

sam: Staging -> p50 ~ -9ms (avg), p99 ~ -45ms, overall token CPU cycles down ~22%. End-to-end token-cost modelled down ~18% after batching tweaks.

olga: Any edge cases? We had one regression on long-seq summarization workloads in staging (p99 +30ms) because our smoother deferred a batch flush. We added a route-exempt list for >2048 tokens.

sam: Correct. We're excluding long-seq and embed-only routes from the initial canary. Canary plan: 25% -> 60% -> 100% over 6 hours if green.

nate: Rollback criteria? Also, what's the monitoring plan?

sam: Rollback triggers: p99 increase >8% sustained for 5 min, error-rate spike >0.4% for route, or GPU-util >95% for more than 2m. Monitoring: new panel microburst-smoothing: p50/p90/p99, error-rate by route, batching latency, and smoother-hit ratio. Alerts wired to oncall via ops-alerts.

lee: We'll watch the canary and run targeted synthetic traffic to hit microbursts. I'll spin up the bench rig at 01:50 UTC and post a quick dump.

deploy-bot: [INFO] Canary rollout scheduled at 02:00 UTC; change_id=mbs-2026-03-23-02; automated rollback enabled.

olga: FYI I added a guidance snippet in the runbook: if a customer reports increased latency after rollout, try prefork.disable=true on their route as a temporary mitigation.

sam: Thanks. Owners: @sam (runtime), @lee (benching), @olga (customer impact). Link to dashboard: https://dash.redwood/microburst-smoothing-canary (internal).

nate: Noted. I'll keep an eye on billing delta too — hope the estimated cost savings hold on prod.

lee: Quick note: we measured tail correlation with small-batcher sizes; tuning param 'smoother.window_ms' default 18 -> 12ms in canary. If we see noise, we can nudge back.

sam: Final: please subscribe to the dashboard and ping this thread if you see anomalies. Will post a short postmortem-style note after the 06:30 triage even if green. :rocket:
